title: 第8章 士兵模板第9章 搬家
slug: 异界冒险从组建冒险团开始
content_zh:
与此同时，沃尔终于看到了他想要的信息。
【霍恩，农民0级，已加入沃尔的队伍】
【扎木合，民兵1级，已加入沃尔的队伍】
【……】
10道提示接连响起，而战旗中的【部队】板块也得到了扩充。
【部队】
〖可组建部队11〗
〖沃尔的队伍〗〖士气52〗
〖士兵1225〗
〖俘虏05〗
沃尔意念一动，士兵一栏立刻展开。
【士兵1225】
〖沃尔·维托亚11〗
〖青狼·维托亚11〗
〖农民0级99〗
〖民兵1级11〗
对于神器战旗展示的更多信息，沃尔很想立刻开始研究，但也不能将刚招募的士兵撂着不管。
沃尔见众人开心的样子，干脆挥手道：
“给你们一个小时时间自由活动，午饭前，所有人在冒险者酒馆汇合。”
十个年轻人都更加高兴，认为自己真是遇到了一个慷慨而仁慈的雇主，纷纷对沃尔再次感谢。

士兵们拿着钱离开，沃尔却并不担心有人卷钱跑路，没人会为了40个铜币就去触犯帝国法律。
在战旗面板中，部队栏中的信息也并没有发生改变，说明这些士兵并不是沃尔担心那样只能死板地跟随自己作战，而是能够派遣出去做事情。
拍了一下青狼的脖子，一人一狗向广场另一边走去。
此刻冒险者工会的早市已经散去，接到任务的冒险者已经离开做任务，没接到任务的冒险者，也去其他地方搞点食物敷衍自己的肚子，少数还在的冒险者也是行色匆匆。
很快，沃尔到了自己的目的地。
【独脚酒馆】
这家酒馆炖菜最美味，不过这里算不上干净，甚至还残留着一股呕吐物，店面还算宽敞，厚重的实木桌椅摆放整齐，不过里面没什么人，只有一个年轻服务生在整理着吧台处的酒杯。
沃尔直接在门口的凳子上坐下，闭上眼睛假装休息，实则开始查看战旗内的信息。
【农民0级，2650】
〖属性：力量10，体质10，敏捷10，智力10，感知10，魅力10〗
〖技能：单手武器20，长杆武器20〗
农民的属性非常均衡，而且9个农民的面板都相同，只有经验值略有差别。
沃尔自然不会认为自己招的是克隆人，而是验证了自己昨天的猜想。
果然，神器战旗的士兵模板，只会不断拉高被赋予者的下限，现实中的实力，可能会略微超出面板所展示的部分。
沃尔暗自点头，继续查看民兵的属性。
【民兵1级，55100】
〖属性：力量11，体质10，敏捷10，智力10，感知10，魅力10〗
〖技能：单手武器25，长杆武器35，跑动20〗
这是扎木合的面板，民兵模板的力量比农民模板高出一点，技能熟练度都有所提升，还多出一个跑动技能。
不过这应该并不是扎木合全部的能力，因为他说过自己会弯弓射箭，这也证明了沃尔刚才的猜想。

他继续看向兵种升级的方向。
【农民0级→民兵1级】
content_en:
Meanwhile, Wall finally sees the information he wants.
[Horn, farmer level 0, has joined Wall's team]
[Zhamuhe, militia level 1, has joined Wall's team]
【……】
10 prompts sounded one after another, and the [troops] section in the battle flag was also expanded.
【troops】
〖Can form 11 troops〗
〖Wall's Team〗〖Morale 52〗
〖Soldier 1225〗
〖Captive 05〗
With a thought from Wall, the column of soldiers immediately unfolded.
【Soldier 1225】
〖Wal Vitoya 11〗
〖Green Wolf Vitoya 11〗
〖Farmer Level 0 99〗
〖Militia Level 111〗
For more information about the artifact war flag, Wall wanted to start researching it immediately, but he couldn't leave the newly recruited soldiers alone.
Seeing how happy everyone was, Wall simply waved and said:
"I'll give you one hour to move around freely. Everyone will meet at the Adventurer's Tavern before lunch."
The ten young people were even more happy, thinking that they had really met a generous and kind employer, and thanked Wall again.
The soldiers took the money and left, but Wall was not worried about anyone using the money to escape. No one would violate the laws of the empire just for 40 copper coins.
In the battle flag panel, the information in the troop column has not changed, indicating that these soldiers are not rigidly following him to fight as Wall worried, but can be sent out to do things.
After patting the green wolf on the neck, one man and one dog walked to the other side of the square.
At this moment, the morning market of the Adventurer's Guild has dispersed. The adventurers who have received the mission have left to do the mission. The adventurers who have not received the mission have also gone to other places to get some food to fill their stomachs. The few adventurers who are still there are also in a hurry.
Soon, Wall arrived at his destination.
【One-legged Tavern】
The stew in this tavern is the most delicious, but it is not clean. There is even a smell of vomit left. The store is quite spacious, and the thick solid wood tables and chairs are arranged neatly. However, there is no one inside. There is only a young waiter arranging the wine glasses at the bar.
Wall sat down directly on the stool at the door, closed his eyes and pretended to rest, but actually began to check the information in the battle flag.
[Farmer level 0, 2650]
[Attributes: Strength 10, Constitution 10, Agility 10, Intelligence 10, Perception 10, Charisma 10]
[Skills: One-handed weapons 20, pole weapons 20]
The attributes of farmers are very balanced, and the panels of the 9 farmers are all the same, with only slight differences in experience values.
Wall naturally did not think that he was recruiting clones, but confirmed his suspicion yesterday.
Sure enough, the soldier template of the artifact battle flag will only continuously increase the lower limit of the person who is given it. The actual strength may slightly exceed the part shown on the panel.
Wall nodded secretly and continued to check the attributes of the militiamen.
[Militia Level 1, 55100]
[Attributes: Strength 11, Constitution 10, Agility 10, Intelligence 10, Perception 10, Charisma 10]
[Skills: One-handed weapon 25, pole weapon 35, running 20]
This is the panel of Zhamuhe. The strength of the militia template is a little higher than that of the peasant template, the skill proficiency has been improved, and there is an additional running skill.
However, this may not be all of Zhamuhe's abilities, because he said that he can bend a bow and shoot arrows, which also proves Wall's conjecture just now.
He continued to look in the direction of troop upgrades.
[Peasant level 0 → Militia level 1]
